mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in labor (UNRATE > 8.5%) and consumer demand (RSAFS < 380,000 million dollars) triggers a negative equity return signal over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both UNRATE>8.5% and RSAFS<380000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5%) amplifies negative equity return expectations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in 3 months and UNRATE > 8.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90 (index 2017=100) signals weakening economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 650 thousand units consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 650, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 227) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signal monetary policy tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 227 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the CPI index above 227 (index 1982-1984=100) signals accelerating inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 227, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
